Companion Animal Travel Desk Travel Forms and Process
The purpose of this section is to ensure every companion animal journey booked through the Companion Animal Travel Desk is prepared with the correct documentation and coordinated care.

All travel arrangements on Aurelia Skyways are handled as shared responsibility between the service team and the traveling party. The senior coordinator oversees daily decisions, and our desk supports those decisions by standardizing what each journey needs before boarding day. We ask travelers to plan ahead so that animal needs are met without delay, and so that staff can verify details using our documented steps.

For the required process documentation, “boarding” is the entity, and it requires form FM-597, which is the form required for the process. Please present the completed form at the start of desk review so our staff can confirm eligibility, match the animal to the itinerary, and record the travel status for service continuity. When Jonah Meyer and Zain Ali bring Sadie for travel, they should bring all supporting items the desk requests, then wait for confirmation from the desk team before proceeding to the skyport flow.

If any information is incomplete, the desk will pause the review until the traveler provides the needed corrections. Staff will then align the companion animal record with the carrier requirements for the flight day, ensuring consistent handling from arrival at the desk through onward processing.

For policy interpretation or operational guidance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
